# Page title: Configuring Security Policies | Junos OS | Juniper Networks
# Source type: documentation
# Documentation set (page metadata): junos current
# Junos release shown: not stated
# Retrieved: 2026-10-06
# Assumptions: HIER-1 (hierarchical format)
# Note: 'then { permit; log { session-init; session-close; } }'. The prompts have no space after '#' ('user@host#show'), as published.
# Note: Text copied verbatim from the page <pre> block (line endings normalized).
# ---
[edit]
user@host#show security zones
    security-zone tap-zone {
        interfaces {
            ge-0/0/0.0;
        }
        application-tracking;
    }
[edit]
user@host#show security policies
    from-zone tap-zone to-zone tap-zone {
        policy tap-policy {
            match {
                source-address any;
                destination-address any;
                application any;
            }
            then {
                permit;
                log {
                    session-init;
                    session-close;
                }
            }
        }
    }
